item.title: HUB75 Power Connections
item.description:
A prototype concept for distributing 5 V power from one supply to the HUB75 LED matrix panels.

Proposed concept

The prototype is deliberately simple:

  • 1 × removable 20 A input for the main 5 V supply;
  • 2 × 4-pole barrier-strip terminals for the HUB75 panel outputs;
  • 1 × additional 2-pole 10 A screw terminal for PCB / auxiliary 5 V;
  • all mounted on a 4 × 6 cm double-sided experiment PCB.

The two 4-pole barrier strips provide eight screw positions in total. Five positions are intended for the five HUB75 panel feeds, leaving three spare positions.

item.title: Power Distribution Examples
item.description:
Examples that inspired the HUB75 power-distribution concept.

These are references, not the proposed design. Verified product images are displayed at up to 240 px wide with source attribution. Where the exact product image cannot be sourced reliably, only the product link is shown.

Promising power-distribution options

Youmile 2 × 10 screw-terminal distribution board

A ready-made board with 10 pairs of screw-terminal outputs (separate positive and negative rails), rather than individual terminal blocks on a prototype PCB. This is very close to the distribution arrangement needed for five HUB75 panels and worth considering instead of assembling the distribution board from separate parts.
